current_activity: SBDs from Henderson Field sink Kinugasa northwest of Rendova
notes: Cressman, Official Chronology of the U.S. Navy, 14 November 1942, records that planes from Enterprise and from Henderson Field attacked the Japanese bombardment force and that USMC SBDs of VMSB-132 sank Kinugasa northwest of Rendova. USMC Operations vol. I, Appendix C, already places the squadron in the Guadalcanal area from 1 November 1942 to 19 January 1943. Craven and Cate, vol. IV, ch. 2, describe the 14 November attacks from Henderson but do not name VMSB-132 on that day, so the earlier 0.5 figure treated this row as an interval-coverage pin. current_activity is changed from "at its base; interval covers this documented operating day" to the Kinugasa wording above. Confidence is raised from 0.5 to 0.7 because Cressman (Navy official chronology) independently confirms the same unit at Henderson Field on 14 November, in agreement with the USMC official appendix interval.
